The main takeaway from our work is that
comparative genomics can provide a framework for the development of a genetic map, even in the absence of a genome sequence.
comparative mapping can be used to develop genetic maps in species that have no existing gene-based genetic maps.
comparative genomics and genetic maps are a powerful tool to study and compare the evolution of plant genomes.
